how_to_steps: Search Google Maps for a local gym without good walkthrough videos; copy the listing link
Go to openart.ai/try and switch to Director Mode
Paste the creator's prompt plus the listing URL and press enter
Wait for the generated walkthrough video (up to 5 min)
Call the gym and sell the video for $500
